info.name: Spring Batch Phone Scoring
info.description:
API collection for the Spring Batch Phone Scoring POC.

Pre-requisites:
1. Start the application with the `local` profile
2. Run the batch job first (POST /api/v1/batch/run) to populate the feature store
3. Then query cheat sheets and feature store data

item.name: Batch Operations
item.description: Endpoints for managing the batch job and querying the feature store.

request.description:
Manually triggers the phone score batch job. This reads mock data from the 3 sources (API, DB replica, S3), computes reach and recovery scores, writes to the feature store, and dispatches the sorted phone list to the configured dialer.

**Run this first** to populate the feature store before querying cheat sheets.
Returns all feature store entries for today, sorted by reach score descending.

query.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if omitted.

request.description: Returns all feature store entries for a specific date, sorted by reach score descending.
Returns the full audit history for a given phone number from the feature store.

item.name: Cheat Sheet (AI-generated)
item.description: Endpoints that generate negotiation cheat sheets using AI (or a mock fallback).

request.description:
Generates a negotiation cheat sheet for the given phone number. Uses the latest entry from the feature store, fills a prompt template, and calls the LLM (or mock provider).

**Note:** Run the batch job first to ensure data exists.
Generates a negotiation cheat sheet for the given user ID.
Shows the response when a phone number is not found in the feature store.
